facts.fact: 他们一路往北赶往海边，耳边全是爆竹声，爆炸一下一下敲在夜色里，远得听不出方位。
facts.anchor: They raced north to the harbourfront with the sound of firecrackers in their ears.

facts.fact: 她给 Hoi 的计划只有一句：挡住怪物，关上那道门。
facts.anchor: “Stop the monsters, close the portal.”

facts.fact: 她笑得自以为有把握，Hoi 的表情却说明并非如此。
facts.anchor: Hoi’s expression said otherwise.

facts.fact: 海边大街上两排英军等着，前排跪姿、后排站立，刺刀朝外对着岛内。
facts.anchor: two rows of British soldiers were waiting: those in front kneeling, the ones behind standing

facts.fact: 她心里明白，突袭的先机已经没有了。
facts.anchor: There went the element of surprise.

facts.fact: 海面上空斜着撕开一道口子，像把现实那层布划破。
facts.anchor: A diagonal slash tearing down through the fabric of reality.

facts.fact: 一条像鳗鱼的怪物从门里蜿蜒钻了出来。
facts.anchor: An eel-like beast had slithered through the portal.

facts.fact: 英军阵线彻底散了，这是她本来会高兴的事。
facts.anchor: The British line fell apart entirely

facts.fact: Por Por 上下打量着那条巨蛇，说那身上有不少好肉。
facts.anchor: “Some good eating on that.”

facts.fact: 她在警署到海边之间捡了根竹竿当拐杖，后来又举起来当剑冲向乱局。
facts.anchor: she had found a bamboo cane to use as a walking stick

facts.fact: 身后黑暗里传来一声嚎叫，她一听就认出是 Archie，只盼他留在原处等她。
facts.anchor: A howl echoed through the darkness behind them.

facts.fact: 严夫人的游行队伍到了，她以九尾狐的原形走在前头，比两层楼还高。
facts.anchor: Madam Yau’s parade had arrived.

facts.fact: Hoi 说「Arrow」号在这边，两人绕开主战场往船上去。
facts.anchor: “The Arrow is this way, come on.”

facts.fact: 拦住他们的是总督 Bowring，端着步枪，与他的领巾和圆眼镜很不相称。
facts.anchor: It was Governor Bowring, his rifle pointed at them.

facts.fact: Bowring 叫她「我的孩子」，问这真的有必要吗，脸上是不快的神色。
facts.anchor: “Is this really necessary, my dear child?”

facts.fact: 总督把怪物说成此地不同的草木鸟兽，还说异乡的台风来得没头没脑。
facts.anchor: the native flora and fauna are different to what we have been accustomed to

facts.fact: Hoi 说动机是战争，Bowring 纠正他：是钱。
facts.anchor: “Money!” Bowring corrected.

facts.fact: 她趁他答话时那一顿，把一把盐撒到他脸上。
facts.anchor: Kiamling used the hesitation in Bowring’s response to throw a handful of salt into his face.

facts.fact: 她低头以为见血，腰间布袋里流出来的却是米。
facts.anchor: Instead, rice trickled out of the pouch at her waist.

facts.fact: 子弹卡在 Archie 送她的运豆符上，两样金属被撞得焊在一处。
facts.anchor: It had lodged against the lucky bean charm Archie had given her.

facts.fact: 也许她的运气已经用完了。
facts.anchor: Or perhaps her luck had run out.
